text:
akash_csm: FYI LuminaHealth onboarding metrics look rough. Token cost +22% week-over-week and p95 latency for /generate hitting ~900ms during nightly batch traffic. Root traces point to huge system prompts + repeated reranks. Thinking proactive ops: route batch windows to reserved capacity + trial an int4 compact model for non-critical requests. Thoughts?
sam_ml: Can you paste the p50/p95/p99 and a sample payload size distribution?
akash_csm: p50 steady ~150ms (baseline), p95 ~900ms, p99 ~1600ms. 30% of requests include context > 3k tokens. Nightly batches at 02:00-03:30 UTC. Cost rise concentrated in rerank-heavy endpoints.
emma_eng: Are they on hosted or dedicated? Any committed spend?
akash_csm: Hosted, free-to-paid trial. No commit yet. Renewal breathing room but this could slow conversion.
sam_ml: Ok. Proposed multi-prong plan: 1) Prefix/KV caching for repeated system text (should cut redundant compute). 2) Canary a compact-7b-int4 for rerank endpoints (lower mem, faster attention on long context). 3) Route scheduled batch windows to a reserved pool (if they sign a short commit) or to a cheaper compact model otherwise. 4) Prompt engineering: auto-trim long system instructions when safe.
emma_eng: Agree. For quality gating we should run a small eval harness: 200 rerank samples + 50 seed prompts; set automatic rollback if semantic cosine < 0.97 or QA drop > 2.5%.
akash_csm: Can we present this as a phased recommendation they can copy into the console? Customer wants minimal risk path.
sam_ml: Phase plan I suggest: Phase 0: telemetry + prefix-caching enabled for 48h. Phase 1: 1% canary compact-7b-int4 on rerank route for 24h. Phase 2: 10% for 48h with gating. Phase 3: scale to 40-50% and reserved-pool during 02:00-03:30 if commit. Include immediate rollback triggers.
emma_eng: I'll author the canary runbook (traffic shifts, monitor panels, rollback commands). Add synthetic load that mimics 3k+ context.
akash_csm: Need concrete config. Sam — can you drop a routing snippet and a short CLI quickstart?
sam_ml: Sure — minimal route override they can paste:```json
{
  "route": "lumina-prod/rerank",
  "schedule_rules": [
    {"when": "02:00-03:30", "preferred": "reserved-pool-eu-west-1", "fallback": "compact-7b-int4"},
    {"when": "default", "preferred": "open-13b-fp16", "fallback": "compact-7b-int4"}
  ],
  "canaries": [
    {"id": "int4-rerank-canary", "model": "compact-7b-int4", "traffic": 1}
  ]
}
```
emma_eng: CLI quickstart for the canary:```bash
# create canary
redwood routes patch lumina-prod/rerank --add-canary id=int4-rerank-canary,model=compact-7b-int4,traffic=1
# enable prefix caching (global)
redwood caching set --prefix-kv enabled --ttl 3600
# set execution profile for compact model
redwood models set-execution-profile compact-7b-int4 --profile int4-lowmem
```
infra-bot: Notice: binding to reserved-pool-eu-west-1 requires quota approval and billing commit. Changes to reserved pools will open a billing PR.
sam_ml: Good call — we'll keep reserved-pool changes manual. For hosted fallback we'll use the fallback field so routing can still serve. I'll run a 10k-sample sim across current vs compact-int4 and post numbers in ~3h.
akash_csm: Also want a one-pager with expected numbers. Any rough estimates now?
sam_ml: Quick estimate: compact-7b-int4 rerank latency p95 -> -40% on long contexts; token cost for rerank slice -~35%. If they shift 25% of rerank traffic, overall token spend ~ -8% and p95 across endpoints drops ~15-20%. I'll validate with sim.
emma_eng: I'll include suggested eval prompts, rollback thresholds, and a checklist for the enablement call.
akash_csm: Sounds great. Can we deliver the one-pager + runbook by EOD PST? I'll schedule a 30m call with the customer for tomorrow morning.
sam_ml: On it — posting sim results here once done.
emma_eng: Drafting runbook now, will attach to the customer email.
akash_csm: Thanks team. After call I'll mark acceptance or iterate.
